title: Baptism as burial with Christ into death and walking in newness of life
english: All of us who have been baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death. For we were buried together with him through baptism into death, so that just as Christ rose from the dead, we too may walk in newness of life (Romans 6:3-4).
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is quoting Paul's words from Romans 6 about what baptism means for believers.

title: Dead to sin, alive to God
english: For we have died to sin; how shall we still live in it? Present your members as weapons of righteousness to God. Glory to God. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is quoting Paul's words from Romans 6 about the believer's death to sin and call to present their members to God.
